title: Rosalind and the Debt
author: Wren Fairweather
blurb: Ulyana Voss, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, has spent twenty years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
